title: Fix launch preflight cleanup leaks
description: BrowserManager.launch adds a profile to _launching before VNC allocation and Firefox startup-state cleanup. Exceptions in those preflight steps must not leave the profile stuck in launching or leak an allocated VNC display.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove VNC allocation failure clears _launching; tests prove startup-state cleanup failure clears _launching and releases the allocated VNC display; existing BrowserManager tests keep passing.
close_reason: Implemented in this session: BrowserManager.launch now clears _launching for VNC allocation failures and releases allocated VNC resources when startup-state cleanup fails. Verified with focused regression tests and full test_browser_manager.py.
